paras.text: THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION,
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2016/1693 concerning restrictive measures against ISIL , para 1

paras.text: Having regard to the Treaty on European Union, and in particular Article 29 thereof,
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2016/1693 concerning restrictive measures against ISIL , para 2

paras.text: Having regard to the proposal from the High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy,
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2016/1693 concerning restrictive measures against ISIL , para 3

paras.text: Whereas:
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2016/1693 concerning restrictive measures against ISIL , para 4
amending Decision (CFSP) 2016/1693 concerning restrictive measures against ISIL , para 5

paras.text: On 20 September 2016, the Council adopted Decision (CFSP) 2016/1693 ( 1 ) .
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2016/1693 concerning restrictive measures against ISIL , para 6
amending Decision (CFSP) 2016/1693 concerning restrictive measures against ISIL , para 7

paras.text: The restrictive measures set out in Article 2(2) and Article 3(3) and (4) of Decision (CFSP) 2016/1693 are to apply until 31 October 2026.
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2016/1693 concerning restrictive measures against ISIL , para 8
amending Decision (CFSP) 2016/1693 concerning restrictive measures against ISIL , para 9

paras.text: Decision (CFSP) 2016/1693 contains a requirement to review the restrictive measures set out therein at regular intervals and at least every 12 months. On the basis of a review of that Decision, the restrictive measures should be extended until 31 October 2027.
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2016/1693 concerning restrictive measures against ISIL , para 10
amending Decision (CFSP) 2016/1693 concerning restrictive measures against ISIL , para 11

paras.text: Decision (CFSP) 2016/1693 should therefore be amended accordingly,
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2016/1693 concerning restrictive measures against ISIL , para 12

paras.text: HAS ADOPTED THIS DECISION:
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2016/1693 concerning restrictive measures against ISIL , para 13

paras.text: In Article 6(6) of Decision (CFSP) 2016/1693, the date ‘31 October 2026’ is replaced by that of ‘31 October 2027’.
paras.loc: Article 1, para 1

paras.text: This Decision shall enter into force on the day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union .
